bookings_trend.description: Area chart showing booking volume over the past 30 days.

revenue_chart.description: Bar chart showing estimated revenue collected over the past 30 days.

top_services.description: Horizontal bar chart ranking services by booking count.

recent_bookings_table.description: Sortable and filterable data table of recent bookings.

staff_bookings.description: Horizontal bar chart showing bookings assigned per staff member.

active_staff.description: Grid of active staff members with role and contact info.

active_coupons.description: Table of currently active discount coupons.

today_availability.description: Today's business hours and open time blocks.

total_clients.description: Stat card showing total registered client count.

bookings.description: View, create, update, and cancel appointments from the admin panel.

services.description: Manage bookable services including name, price, duration, and availability.

clients.description: Browse and manage the client directory with per-client booking history.

staff.description: Manage staff members who can be assigned to appointments.

availability.description: Configure business hours and recurring weekly availability windows.

categories.description: Organise services into a nested category hierarchy.

questions.description: Define intake form questions collected from customers at booking time.

coupons.description: Create and manage discount coupon codes redeemable during checkout.

settings.description: Top-level group for business configuration options.

business_info.description: Set the business name, contact details, and public-facing description.

business_location.description: Set the physical address displayed to customers.

timezone.description: Choose the timezone used for all appointment scheduling and display.

booking_interval.description: Set the slot granularity (e.g. 15 min, 30 min) shown in the booking calendar.

my_bookings.description: Let authenticated customers view and manage their own upcoming and past bookings.

booking_flow.description: End-to-end public booking wizard: service selection, date/time picking, and checkout.

coupons.description: Allow customers to enter a coupon code during checkout to receive a discount.

staff_selection.description: Show an optional staff preference picker in the booking flow when the service has a staff role assigned.

services_browse.description: Public-facing page listing all visible services so customers can explore offerings before booking.

exception_times.description: Allow staff members to block out time ranges (holidays, breaks) that override normal availability.
